Main only, after active official model closes; source packet is not applied/qualified.
1. Review exact3file patch/lifecycle/callback layers and Drive copy placement; apply in NEW isolated
   consumer, pin source/build. Full free+contrib-llvm compile and required no-new lint; host ASan/UBSan.
   No claim CPU-only from bytes_needed/mmq: any helper touching Runtime remains Main GPU-owned.
2. Meaningful CPU actual-dispatch fixture: load small valid native layout metadata using existing
   expert_layout_load/native parity setup; construct deterministic valid synthetic IQ blocks/activation
   and ExpertSource, actual ExpertPool, no GPU plan/cache/remote, then actual expert_pool_dispatch_multi.
   Bind scope and controlled routedIDs: one repeated expert across8rows ->oneNT8job; disjoint experts
   ->NT1jobs; mixed repetitions ->allNT1..8 possible across cases; mixed GU/Down types per layer; tailT1.
   Capture stderr, assert per-layer jobs=sumNTbuckets and rows=sum(nt*bucket), formatIDs equal actuallayout,
   compare all actual pool output floats enabled/disabled (bitwise where original kernel permits).
   Do not replace production dispatch with fabricated counter updates/another math kernel.
3. Two sequential request scopes with different jobs: second startszero, no cumulative subtraction;
   multiple serial bindings aggregate once; finish twice/destructor prints once; early return/error
   reports partial status; unsupported>64/non-native/no-pool/batch configs remain unchanged math/no data.
   Saturation/invalid helpers may need dedicated internal CPU test access to actual implementation;
   no mirrored add algorithm. No test-only ABI exposure added in this packet.
4. Thread/lifetime CPU stress for actual atomic shared ownership: dispatch-side recorded calls concurrent
   with finish/detach, retained state inactive prevents further counts; snapshot exact only after joined
   writer. TSan if useful separate from production callbacks. Overlap bind must flaginvalid not replace.
   Review source no callback can be attributed to next request before existing completion boundaries.
5. Main owned small real-model serial read_windows8 opt-inOFF/ON on exactsame native/profile/prompt/env:
   finite budgets/current health/source/runtime pins; normalQUIT/fault gates; same token/logit/output
   comparisons and existing completionguards. Confirm prompt-only64-or-fewerlines, no decode/calibration
   counts, layer format IDs. Error/STOP/nonfinite/reused/checkpoint-split two-request samples preserve
   status/partial histogram, no poison recache/regression. No canceled sample becomes complete data.
6. Actual batched8192 arm: zero serial CPUhistogram work marker, no NT8192 buckets. Mixed-route sample
   explicitly partial serial coverage. Do not run another timing/profiler/hardware sweep just for this.
   If actual task now needs roofline weighting, use closed actual histogram+existing stats separately
   from synthetic kernel-only benchmarks/RAM historical bandwidth; no inferred measuredDRAM/PCIe bytes.
7. Keep every individual compact histogram/status/hash/source/env/correctness/fault decision. Main
   manages committed evidence and bounded raw retirement under lock; no cleanup performed by packet.
